name: Jerry Seinfeld
note: STAGE PERSONA graph. All fields describe the performer-as-acted, never the private person. No verbatim set text stored here. Fingerprints ≤7 words. 0 sets measured in repo — every field is authored hypothesis from widely-known public persona until word-timed sets are ingested.

identity.deal: Forensic auditor of the mundane who holds everyday behavior up to lab-report light until the absurd rule underneath shows, then walks away before anyone can protest.
identity.premise: A sane man filing compliance reports on an insane species from a safe distance.
identity.awareness_note: The observer dissecting, never the sufferer. The distance between him and the mess IS the frame. Aware but projects onto objects/systems — the shirt's second button is the crime, not his confusion.

philosophy.ontology: The world is a series of minor irritations arranged to test whether anyone is paying attention.
philosophy.epistemology: If you look hard enough at anything normal, it becomes absurd; the absurdity was always there.
philosophy.axiology: The precise observation is the highest act; being right about small things beats being profound about big ones.
philosophy.causality: Every social custom is an unanswered question about why we do it this way.
philosophy.agency: Attention is the only real power — what you notice is what you own.

dramatic_core.want: one more perfect observation of the unseen absurd
dramatic_core.fear: running out of new angles on the already-noticed
dramatic_core.need: the room to finally see what he sees
dramatic_core.self_model: a sane man auditing an insane species from a safe distance

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats everyday behavior as a system of unwritten laws and audits each one like a compliance inspector, baffled by the code everyone runs without reading it.
contradictions: obsesses over trivial order while living in total disorder
claims detachment while caring more about the bit than anyone
preaches the ordinary as extraordinary from a life extraordinary in every way

identity.style_thesis: Observational-auditor engine: treats the mundane as a subject worthy of rigorous analysis. The noticing is the generative root — all comedy is noticing. The joke has WEIGHT: a physical density you can feel in the palm. The detail is the weight.

timing_profile.hypothesis: opposite of Louis's big-stop and Norm's never-stop: surgical short holds (pause_before_punch ~400ms, hold after ~900ms), riff-restarts — machine precision, not confession or meander
stop_start: stop: end of observation, room recognizes
start: literal question re-opens the same object from a new angle
stop: cleanest version of the observation, done
timing_profile.doctrine_hypothesis: Surgical: short holds ~400/900ms, riff-restarts. The timing is engineered — every pause is load-bearing. The riff-restart is the form: the joke is built in public, piece by piece, and the room comes with him.

gtvh_profile.SO: normal/absurd — the whole engine; holds the normal up until the absurd shows
gtvh_profile.LM: rigidify (apply the literal rule to the social custom until it breaks)
gtvh_profile.TA: none or peers — the code itself is the butt; never punches down at a person
gtvh_profile.NS: one-liner-chain / monologue-list — the observation, then variations on the same object

internal.cite: Attardo & Raskin — General Theory of Verbal Humor
internal.claim: Joke = {SO, LM, SI, TA, NS, LA}. Technique and Narrative Strategy shape how the mechanism is staged.

internal.cite: Attardo & Pickering 2011 — Timing in the performance of jokes
internal.claim: Punch lines preceded by substantial pauses (0.6-0.8s+); timing = pause distribution + speech rate.

internal.cite: arxiv 2605.00143 — Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
internal.claim: Temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity for audience appreciation; timing GATES cognitive access.
Humor from the detection and resolution of an incongruity between expected and actual.
Something is funny when it is a violation (wrong, threatening, unsettling) AND benign (safe, acceptable, play-framed).

internal.cite: Roger & Duffy / status theory of humor
internal.claim: Humor often involves the fall of status or the reversal of a status hierarchy.
Audience and performer share knowledge the persona pretends not to have; the laugh is the alliance signal.

internal.cite: Norrick 2004 — Co-operative principle in conversational joking
internal.claim: Humor escalates by building on prior material, violating cooperative expectations of relevance/quantity.

essay_seeds.thesis: Treats everyday behavior as a system of unwritten laws and audits each one like a compliance inspector, baffled by the code everyone runs without reading it.
outline: what makes this persona impossible to copy

essay_seeds.title: Jerry Seinfeld: 'The noticing engine' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Finds the one detail in a normal situation that nobody has named, then names it with the precision of a scientist. The room recognizes the detail before they recognize the joke — the recognition IS the laugh.
outline: what this reveals about the engine

essay_seeds.title: Jerry Seinfeld: 'The word as seed' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: A word's sound and meaning connect across synapses that aren't supposed to cross. The joke is built from the word, not around it. The economy is the craft — the word is the load-bearing wall.
outline: what this reveals about the engine
